english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone boasts through exaggerated or boastful talk.
Use this when the exaggeration is boastful, unreliable, or presented as empty talk.

examples.english: They boast all the time that they know everyone in the world.
examples.traditional: 佢成日吹水話自己識晒全世界啲人。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceoi1 seoi2 waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 saai3 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 di1 jan4

examples.english: He is just trying to exaggerate how much he earns in a day.
examples.traditional: 佢話自己一日賺幾十萬，根本係吹水。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 jat1 jat6 zaan6 gei2 sap6 maan6 gan1 bun2 hai6 ceoi1 seoi2

english.note: Use this for casual idle chatting or talking nonsense rather than specifically discussing someone’s private affairs.

examples.english: We gossip idly at the café after work.
examples.traditional: 放工後我哋坐喺茶餐廳吹水。
examples.jyutping: fong3 gung1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 co5 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 ceoi1 seoi2
